<div class="card-body">
'''Medium Transport''' is a [[Light]] [[Starship]] ([[Capital]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">中型輸送艇</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1名のパイロットと4名の乗客、1つのビークルを乗せられる。配備と移動に関しては、宇宙戦闘機と同様に扱う。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Medium-Transport-PSA-92654383.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ギャロフリー・ヤーズ製の人員／貨物輸送艇。巨大な貨物庫は艤装次第で多数の兵員や弾薬、補給物資などを収容できる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Medium Transport.

'''Card text:'''
May carry 1 pilot, 4 passengers, and 1 vehicle. Treat deploy and move like a starfighter. Has docking capability. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

'''Lore:'''
A personnel and cargo transport built by Gallofree Yards. Its huge cargo bays can, depending on outfitting, hold many troops, munitions, and supplies.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 大型艦：輸送艇.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Medium Transport]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
